scope.research_boundary: Audit only the already-linked candidate files, source records, research-attempt files, B150 scope/results, and registered campaign records. Determine whether the existing B150 evidence supports any exact retained candidate field. No new web query, XHS/public-post query, page open, URL retry, source creation, or external contact is in scope. Root is the sole writer. For unsupported fields, convert the latest B150 open attempt to blocked with a concise exact-model reason and preserve all earlier attempts and campaign history. Promote a field only where already-linked exact evidence meets the frozen field rules; preserve model, trim, seller-option, and market ambiguity.
field_rules: A complete-bike weight must match the retained exact build and preserve size, included equipment, approximation, and weighing basis; frame weight cannot substitute.
Drivetrain evidence must establish the exact series, speeds, layout, actuation, and selected retained build.
Tire clearance requires an exact-model maximum; fitted tire size alone does not establish the maximum.
Frame weight, material/construction, and stiffness evidence must match the exact target and stated generation/trim; do not infer layup, grade, or stiffness.
excluded: No image, price, warranty, purchase-route, UI, or unrelated catalog changes.
No external delivery, GitHub mutation, commit, push, PR, merge, publish, or production write.
